On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Maple Ridge total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Cottonwood fell from 43 in June to 36 in October (−16.3%), and 34 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 13.4% of Maple Ridge’s 268 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Cottonwood?

blocks.text: Cottonwood, Maple Ridge Condos and Townhomes: streets and boundaries

items.t: Cottonwood is a board sub-area name, not a City neighbourhood: the City of Maple Ridge's neighbourhoods page lists Albion/Kanaka, Port Hammond, Port Haney, Ruskin, Silver Valley, Thornhill, Town Centre, Webster's Corners, Whonnock and Yennadon, and no Cottonwood.

The attached stock sits around two elementary schools and a creek: Kanaka Creek Elementary, 11120 234A Street, and Alexander Robinson Elementary, 11849 238B Street, west of 240 Street and east of the Town Centre, with Kanaka Creek running through the area to the Fraser River.

blocks.text: Cottonwood, Maple Ridge Condos and Townhomes: the housing stock

items.t: One townhome-form community at the sub-area's north edge is not strata at all: St. George's Village Seniors Housing Co-operative, 23580 Dewdney Trunk Road, where the co-op's own form states the age qualification for membership is 55 years, that members buy shares rather than strata lots, and that a $3,500 non-refundable transfer fee applies on a share transfer.
Cottonwood Park, 11600 Cottonwood Drive, is income-based subsidized rental housing operated by Red Door Housing Society, not a strata a buyer can purchase into.

blocks.text: Cottonwood, Maple Ridge Condos and Townhomes: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Creek-side strata lots carry a watercourse check other Maple Ridge townhome areas do not: Kanaka Creek is a salmon-bearing watercourse protected inside Kanaka Creek Regional Park, and Metro Vancouver warns of steep, slippery cliffs along the creek, especially at Cliff Falls.

Flood status is lot-specific here: the City's flood material covers the Fraser River floodplain, and whether a specific Cottonwood lot is in a mapped floodplain is checked on the City's flood maps, not from the listing.

blocks.text: Cottonwood, Maple Ridge Condos and Townhomes: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The hatchery is a working salmon facility, not just a park feature: Kanaka Creek Regional Park's Bell-Irving Hatchery supports chum and coho salmon and cutthroat trout.

Two named trail systems start inside the sub-area's parkland: the Canyon Trail runs 1.2 kilometres one way from the hatchery to Cliff Falls, and the Riverfront Trails run 3 kilometres one way at the creek oxbow and the Fraser River.
No City recreation centre sits in Cottonwood: the Maple Ridge Leisure Centre is at 11925 Haney Place in the Town Centre, west of every Cottonwood complex.
No library branch sits in Cottonwood either: Maple Ridge Public Library is at 22470 Dewdney Trunk Road in the Town Centre.
School District No. 42 has no middle tier: elementary schools run Kindergarten to Grade 7 and secondary schools Grades 8 to 12, so a Cottonwood townhome family changes schools once, after Grade 7.
Ridge Meadows Hospital, 11666 Laity Street, is the community hospital for Maple Ridge and Pitt Meadows, with 24/7 emergency care.

blocks.text: Cottonwood, Maple Ridge Condos and Townhomes: development and new projects

items.t: South of Cottonwood, Council adopted the Lougheed Transit Corridor Area Plan, directing growth around future Bus Rapid Transit stations along Lougheed Highway and Dewdney Trunk Road, which is the corridor Cottonwood townhome owners use to reach Haney Place.

blocks.text: Cottonwood, Maple Ridge Condos and Townhomes: costs and taxes

items.t: The co-operative at 23580 Dewdney Trunk Road carries a cost no strata in the area does: a $3,500 non-refundable transfer fee on a share transfer, stated on the co-op's own form.

For any strata townhome here, the Province's buying guidance directs buyers to review strata fees, bylaws and any special levies before removing subjects; no municipal page states a Cottonwood complex's strata fee.

blocks.text: Cottonwood, Maple Ridge Condos and Townhomes: getting around

items.t: The 745 Haney Place / Cottonwood is the route named for this sub-area on TransLink's Haney Place route diagram.
The 745 and 746 Haney Place / Albion interline at Jackson Road at 103 Avenue, forming one circular service, so a Cottonwood rider's return bus may arrive signed as an Albion bus.
Lougheed Highway and Dewdney Trunk Road are the east–west corridors south and north of the townhome streets, and Haney Place in the Town Centre is the exchange the area's routes connect to.

blocks.text: Cottonwood, Maple Ridge Condos and Townhomes: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check flood first for creek-adjacent complexes: the City's flood guide covers the Fraser River floodplain, and the City publishes flood maps a buyer can search by address.

Treat creek banks as a hazard, not only an amenity: Metro Vancouver notes steep slippery cliffs along Kanaka Creek, especially at Cliff Falls, inside the regional park that Cottonwood complexes back onto.

blocks.text: Cottonwood home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

75 townhomes sold in Cottonwood with a median price of $750,000 (the middle half sold between $716,200 and $830,500), taking a median of 27 days to sell at 97.9% of the last list price; 3% sold above list. They had a median $484 per square foot, a median year built of 2015 and a median strata fee of $373 a month.

faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in Cottonwood had a sales ratio of 14%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
faq.q: Is Cottonwood a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?

faq.a: 34 condos and townhomes sold in Cottonwood over those 5 months, out of 230 in all of Maple Ridge.
